text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the "U.A.F." test tournament 
has finally arrived. The tournament's 
events will be broadcast in real time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Led by Sonon Elfie, the participating 
athletes were burning with fighting 
spirit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The new entertainment "U.A.F." —The time 
had finally come to take on its trial 
tournament!
